stories.title: R7-42 — Top Pairings click highlights and labels neighbors on the network
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the 'Top Pairings' CollapsibleSection header in IngredientPanel calls onHighlightPairings with the list of all sortedNeighbors' names (existing wiring at src/components/IngredientPanel.jsx:562 and 879).
Clicking the 'Common Pairings (N) ↗' header when 2+ ingredients are selected calls onHighlightPairings with commonPairings names (existing wiring at src/components/IngredientPanel.jsx:536 and 853).
App.jsx toggles highlightPairings (null ↔ names) on each call — pressing the header twice clears it (existing wiring at src/App.jsx:1006-1008 and 1540-1542).

LivingArchView creates a Three.js label sprite (makeLabel) at each highlighted node's mode-position (src/components/LivingArchView.jsx:1865-1890); sprites are torn down + recreated when highlightPairings changes.
AffinityMode engaged-guard at LivingArchView.jsx:1865 prevents duplicate label sprites when α-mode owns labels; confirm this branch still no-ops correctly.

New vitest at src/components/__tests__/IngredientPanel.r7-42.test.jsx (or extend existing IngredientPanel test) asserts: rendering the panel for an ingredient with N neighbors, clicking the Top Pairings header invokes onHighlightPairings exactly once with the full neighbor-name array (order preserved by strength desc); clicking it again invokes it again with the same array (toggle is delegated to App.jsx, not the panel).
The new vitest test passes: `npx vitest run src/components/__tests__/IngredientPanel.r7-42.test.jsx` exits 0.

stories.title: R8-49 — Training trajectory becomes a one-shot onboarding modal gated on localStorage
acceptanceCriteria: New component src/components/TrainingTraceModal.jsx exists, default-exports a React modal that inlines the loss-curve + 2D PCA embedding playback logic currently in TrainingProgress.jsx (so TrainingProgress.jsx becomes deletable in US-03 without losing playback functionality).
Modal accepts props { isOpen, onClose } and renders a centered overlay (z-50, fixed inset-0 backdrop, accessible role='dialog', aria-modal='true', aria-labelledby pointing at the title).
Modal includes a close button (Escape + click-on-backdrop also dismiss) and a 'Got it' CTA that calls onClose.
Modal renders the same loss-curve SVG and the same 2D PCA scatter SVG as TrainingProgress.jsx (same trace.frames data shape, same TASTE_COLORS palette).
Modal fetches /models/training_trace.json on first open only — subsequent re-opens reuse the cached trace.

App.jsx (or a dedicated hook) triggers the modal once per user via localStorage key 'fn-training-trace-seen': on mount, if localStorage.getItem('fn-training-trace-seen') !== '1' AND useProData has finished loading, open the modal; the close handler sets localStorage['fn-training-trace-seen']='1' wrapped in try/catch for private-mode Safari.
URL param ?reset=trace clears the localStorage flag before reading it (mirrors the existing fn-start-seen ?reset=start convention from useProData docs).

New vitest at src/components/__tests__/TrainingTraceModal.test.jsx asserts: (a) modal is hidden when isOpen=false; (b) modal renders title + Got it button when isOpen=true; (c) clicking Got it invokes onClose; (d) Escape keypress invokes onClose. Mocks fetch to return a minimal valid trace ({ frames: [{ epoch: 1, loss: 0.5, embeddings: [[0,0]] }], compound_labels: ['sweet'] }).
The new vitest test passes: `npx vitest run src/components/__tests__/TrainingTraceModal.test.jsx` exits 0.
